SMARTMeasurementCriterion: Doctor-search page response time <= 2s with 500 concurrent users.
The system shall achieve >= 99.5% monthly uptime (excluding scheduled maintenance).
Medical record data shall be encrypted with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit.
The system shall follow data-minimization principles for personal data.
The system shall handle 3x booking volume growth over 12 months without architecture changes.
A first-time user shall complete their first booking in <= 3 minutes without guidance.
The system shall raise a conflict warning within <= 1 second when a doctor double-booking is detected.
The system shall recover booking data within 15 minutes after an incident (RPO<=5min, RTO<=15min).
Source code shall achieve >= 80% unit-test coverage for the booking module.
The UI shall work correctly on Chrome, Safari, Edge versions released in the last 2 years.
